rulings.reading: schools-of-magic.md heads its lists 'Common Schools (0-70%)' and 'Less Common Schools (71-100%)' and gives no share to any one school (70 does not divide among four). Ruled (tarmar-studio #18): a caster rolls d100 once on this table, the row it lands on is the list the caster's school comes from, and the player chooses one school from that list. A row naming one school would give it outright. A Game Master may roll again or set any school.

The pages say a spell is learned with skill points (spell-mastery.md) and call Detect Magic 'learnable from either track' (spell-descriptions.md), so a caster learns from their own school. Ruled (tarmar-studio #18): a player puts points into a spell they do not yet know only when it is of their school, and only once the school is rolled and chosen; a spell already on the record may be raised whatever its school; a Game Master may teach any spell, which is recorded as outside the caster's school. Weather, Counter and Arcane/True Magic have no spells in the battle's catalog yet, so a caster of one of them learns spells only from a Game Master.
